content.short: Wildcard is an epic PVP CCG-based MOBA video game.
content.description: Wildcard fuses collectible card game mechanics with real-time MOBA strategy to create a fast-paced, spectator-friendly experience that keeps audiences engaged from start to finish. By marrying traditional gameplay with cutting-edge technology, it enables a new form of competitive play where players can compete, collect, and connect across an expanding ecosystem. Led by co-founders Paul Bettner and Katy Drake Bettner, Wildcard aims to extend the immersive Wildcard Universe well beyond simply playing the game, inviting fans into a living world of strategy, competition, and collaboration.
content.meta: Wildcard is an epic PVP CCG-based MOBA video game, and everyone’s invited to play. Discover Wildcard and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
